author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Sea drones injured eight people in the Russian Black Sea resort of Sochi late Wednesday, authorities in the surrounding Krasnodar region said in a statement reported by Reuters.

Officials said beach infrastructure was partially damaged. Reuters verified social-media video showing weapons fire and an explosion near an embankment, with people heard screaming. The report did not provide details on the conditions of those injured or identify who launched the drones.

Sochi is a major resort city and hosted the 2014 Winter Olympics. Russian President Vladimir Putin also has an official residence in the area, increasing the security significance of an attack near the city’s waterfront.

Ukraine has carried out frequent aerial-drone strikes against Russian energy, export and logistics infrastructure during the war, but attacks using sea drones have been less common. No claim of responsibility was included in the initial report, so attribution remains unresolved. The casualty count and damage assessment may change as regional authorities release additional information.
dek: Regional authorities reported injuries and damage to beach infrastructure after explosions late Wednesday; Reuters verified video from the waterfront.
headline: Sea drones injure eight in Russia’s Black Sea resort of Sochi
